study: Olson et al. 2017 (Pathway Project, AUHSD replication; J. Educ. Psych. 109(1))
eval_evidence: Authored/conducted by the Pathway Project developers (Carol Booth Olson et al.); developer-run RCT and impact analyses under the Pathway to Academic Success grant; no independent evaluator.
developer_evidence: p.18: 'Training was led by the developers of the Pathway Project and supported by literacy coaches who participated as Pathway teachers in a previous quasi-experimental research study.' Developers delivered the 46h/year PD.
cascade_evidence: Developers led the training directly; veteran Pathway teacher-coaches provided support (not a train-the-trainer intermediary) -> developer_direct.
counterfactual_evidence: Comparison = business-as-usual district training (extraction record/design: control got typical district training). Coded business_as_usual (the report frames control as BAU district practice; no equal-dose active alternative PD documented as in the SAUSD 2012 trial).
coaching_evidence: 46h/year training (six 6-hour release days + five 2-hour afterschool sessions) plus coaching from a veteran Pathway teacher; recurring monthly+/biweekly in-class coaching cycles are not documented -> occasional.
student_dose_evidence: Pure teacher PD; only the teachers' own ELA (analytical reading/writing) instruction changes. No tutoring, pull-out, or added student-facing dose.
maturity_evidence: Headline/primary contrast is Year 2 (2013-14), teachers in their second program year (Year-2 students taught by second-year-program teachers); a Year-1 cohort (first_year) is also reported. Coded mature for the headline wave; note Year-1 cohort exists.
